name: x-train-for-misty-30
objective: NOT A LINK. Route 4's grass again, to level 30 instead of 24, for asking whether any level a player can reach by grinding answers Misty for the Charmander line.
evidence: watch:lead_level>=30 - wPartyMon1Level $D18C, the same address link 27's goal reads. This scenario exists only to sweep the threshold; scenarios/experiments/ is never read by chain_files, so nothing here can join the chain.

30 is where the CHARMANDER line's damage model stops improving against Misty: CHARMELEON at 30 still needs nine turns to kill STARMIE and still dies in three, because WATER GUN is 2x on FIRE and its own best move is a 40-power SCRATCH at 1x. brock.md measured the mirror of this at Brock and found a plateau rather than a curve; this is the same sweep on the other gym.
